function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a workspace-relative UTF-8 text file, maximum64KiB. Does not follow symlinks.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List entries in a workspace-relative directory, without following symlinks.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Atomically write a workspace-relative file after approval. Parent directories must exist. Maximum64KiB.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact unique old_string in a workspace-relative file, after approval. Refuses ambiguous or concurrent changes.

function.name: run_shell
function.description: Run an unrestricted /bin/sh command as your user after explicit approval, with captured output and1–120s timeout.

function.name: spawn_agent
function.description: Start a native subagent with a separate conversation and saved session. Read-only is the default. Inherit/write mode uses parent approval for each mutation. Up to three run concurrently.

function.name: wait_agent
function.description: Wait for one native agent up to timeout_seconds; running status does not mean complete.

function.name: list_agents
function.description: List native child agents and their running/completed/cancelled status.

function.name: cancel_agent
function.description: Cancel and reap one native child process group.

function.name: send_agent_message
function.description: Continue a completed agent using its saved transcript. Requires session saving; sending to a running agent is rejected.

function.name: list_mcp_servers
function.description: List configured optional MCP servers without starting them.

function.name: connect_mcp_server
function.description: Start one configured local stdio MCP server after approval and discover its tools. Use the server identifier from list_mcp_servers.
